mistakes.title: Via in SMD pad
mistakes.explanation: Via found in SMD pad 9 of U1. During reflow soldering, solder can wick down into the via, resulting in insufficient solder on the pad and unreliable connections.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Move the via outside the pad area, or specify via-in-pad with filled and capped vias in the manufacturing notes. Via-in-pad increases cost but is acceptable when properly filled.

mistakes.title: Thermal pad may need more vias
mistakes.explanation: U1 thermal pad has only 2 via(s) nearby. For effective heat transfer to the ground plane, 4-9 vias are typically recommended under the thermal pad.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add more thermal vias under U1's thermal pad. Use 0.3mm drill vias in a grid pattern. Consider via-in-pad with filling if assembly process allows.
